audience.all.note: the audience of a campaign sent to every list

problem.readOnlySent: This campaign was sent. Duplicate it to reuse the content.

problem.readOnlySentOn.message: This campaign was sent on {date}. Duplicate it to reuse the content.

problem.senderScope.note: a member whose role is scoped to some sender domains

problem.listScope.note: a member whose role is scoped to some lists

problem.variantLetter.message: Each variant needs its own letter.

problem.approvalWouldCancel.note: status: pending or approved; name: who approved

label.sampleNoContacts: Sample contact · no contacts in this audience yet

label.firstNameSet.note: a preview contact who has a first name; first_name is a field key

label.noFirstNameFallback.note: a preview contact without a first name: the email shows the fallback

label.perRecipient.note: the preview's value of a link that's different for each recipient (unsubscribe, poll answers)

version.fromTemplate.note: a version's label in the composer's history; name: the template's name, never translated

version.fromWebPost.note: the first version of a campaign made from a post of the publication website

version.copiedFrom.note: the first version of a duplicate; name: the original campaign's name, never translated

version.fromPost.note: the first version of a draft made from a WordPress post; site: blog.acme.io

note.draftFrom.note: the campaign list's note of a draft made from a WordPress post; site: blog.acme.io
